name: Aila
description: Agentic AI for US mortgage teams — intake/compliance agents that listen to discovery calls, build the loan file in LOS/CRM (ARIVE, LendingPad, etc.), request docs, score compliance. From ~$50/LO/mo (intake+compliance); enterprise ~$200/LO/mo. Homepage also at withaila.com.

mentions.evidence: ~$18.1k MRR, 99 active subscriptions, ~$18.7k L30, ~$116k all-time, ~100 users claimed, founded Nov 2023, US. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Own one regulated sales call → system-of-record pipeline (mortgage, insurance, wealth). Charge per producer; integrate the LOS they already live in.

whyItPrints: Vertical workflow glue for loan officers (not a general chatbot). Clear ACV per LO, ~99 paying seats, sticky once wired into LOS — Conductor-shaped but for mortgage ops instead of QuickBooks Desktop.
